scope: Show estimated generation speed before provider completion

behavior.live_estimate: Received UTF-8 output bytes / 4 / seconds since first output, marked with ~
behavior.warmup: Generating for the first 250 ms to suppress the initial packet spike
behavior.refresh: Existing 100 ms UI tick; no extra network requests or tokenizer dependencies
behavior.output: Content, thinking and tool-input deltas when supplied by the adapter; completion is not counted again
behavior.final: Provider count/duration replaces the live estimate; observed client duration remains marked with ~ when provider duration is unavailable
behavior.cleanup: Per-session and per-model; reset for each provider attempt; cleared on completion, cancellation, error and disconnect; no generation rate during tools or approvals
behavior.privacy: Streaming metrics retain only model identity, byte count and timing, never generated text
behavior.limitation: A provider or adapter that buffers output until completion cannot supply a live estimate; the UI waits rather than inventing tokens. Byte estimates vary by model and language.

validation.focused_race: passed: stream lifecycle, packet-independent counts, thinking deduplication, footer state, layout and configurable-agent forwarding
validation.vet: passed: affected production packages and integration-tagged TUI

controlled_pty.transport: Shipped binary in a real PTY; paced native Ollama HTTP fixture on loopback
controlled_pty.proof: Awaiting state before first output; estimated speed while server still withheld completion; further streamed output; final eval_count=40 / eval_duration=2s displayed as 20.0 tok/s without ~
controlled_pty.test_correction: Initial assertion incorrectly matched SPEED_DONE in the user's prompt. Replaced with an atomic server-completion marker to prove the response was still open.

real_ollama_pty.scope: Real project explanation with citations, provider navigation, permission prompts, approved Bash command, live command output, PTY input and queued instructions. This test does not assert that every native Ollama reply streams partial content.
